notes: Scoped as a hard four-part scientific-computing task (floor is driven by the separability-matrix competency whose comparator B.4 demands hard). (1) The separability computation for nested/stacked/blocked astropy compound models requires implementing coordinate-transform composition that corrects the over-coupling a naive sequential decomposition produces — genuine reasoning_depth=3 (verified against astropy ground truth). (2) The cross-entropy optimizer must preserve the probability tensor's shape while also mounting a shared-prefix memo that reproduces the exact reward and is >2x faster on overlapping batches (quantitative_correctness=3, hidden_case_generalization=3 across all hidden fixtures). (3) The ARS component must return statistically correct samples for multiple log-concave targets in R, exercised on hidden densities (moments + counts). (4) The lorentzian fitter must crop per-peak windows and honor exact tolerances not only on clean single peaks but on multi-peak, zero-offset, constant, and empty/malformed spectra (adversarial_inputs=2, hidden_case_generalization). Independent numeric/probabilistic references (astropy matrix ground truth, direct reward recompute, reference moments) make the checks exact rather than lax. Multi-tool breadth (numpy/scipy/astropy on the Python side plus an R runtime) raises tool_breadth=3; the four components are welded together only by the shared deliverable harness, so dependent_stages=2. Time budget 2700s reflects the separability rewrite plus R statistical validation.
